name: Dereva Prep
description: Driving-test prep app for Kenyan learner drivers, built around the model town board that many students fail on.
longDescription:
Dereva Prep helps Kenyan learner drivers prepare for the driving test. I started it as a student at driving school, after I saw more than 40 students in one class struggle with the model town board. The app runs on a KSh 500 monthly subscription. I grow it with Facebook and TikTok ads and use PostHog to find where the funnel loses people.

In the week of 12 October 2026 the ads lost money: KSh 1,432 of ad spend brought KSh 1,251 of revenue. I used PostHog funnels to find where users stopped between the ad and the payment. I moved the paywall before sign-up, replaced the KSh 200 weekly plan with a KSh 500 monthly plan, and set the ads to optimise for sales, not leads. In the next week, KSh 1,303 of ad spend brought KSh 3,800 of revenue, a 2.9x return. Weekly revenue went up 3 times.
